summary: Join our training course to understand how oil and gas drive global economic growth. Gain insights and expertise to excel in this critical industry.
lede: Oil and gas business development training explores how the sector shapes economic development, markets and public policy. It is for professionals in policy, investment, energy and development who assess effects on budgets, employment, trade and industrial growth. Learners examine value chains and revenue flows, assess volatility and resource dependence, and consider diversification and energy-transition strategies.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for a diverse audience of professionals directly involved in shaping, financing, regulating, or analyzing energy and development policies.
audience: Executives in oil and gas companies
Sovereign wealth fund and national investment authority
outcomes: Oil And Gas Value Chain Analysis
modules: Global Energy Landscape and Economic Systems
Understanding the Oil and Gas Value Chain
Geopolitics of Oil and Global Power Dynamics
Oil and Gas in Sustainable Development
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites, but a basic understanding of economics or energy sector dynamics is beneficial.
